caption.what_it_says: Integrated battery enclosure: no loss until pressure ratio, (event 3-s gust ÷ declared reference 3-s gust)² reaches about 0.46; under the central screening scenario damage rises, passing half of its maximum near 1.16, and reaches a damage ratio of 0.92 (92 % of the part's value) by 1.96. The other scenarios reach half of their maximum at different demands: the lower resistance scenario near 0.95 and the upper resistance scenario near 1.36. They are alternatives, never averaged. Above 2 the model withholds an answer instead of guessing.
